name: Progress
description: A horizontal bar showing how far a task has got, or that it's working when progress is unknown.

props.name: label
props.description: What is progressing; the bar's accessible name.

props.name: value
props.description: 0-100. Leave it out for an indeterminate bar.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the percentage next to the label.

a11y: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax; no value when indeterminate.
The visible label is the accessible name.
The indeterminate animation stops for prefers-reduced-motion.
